My verdict is **PASS** for DG1 round 13 on candidate `sha256:00f1498c…c80b`. Before I started, HEAD was `ed2160d`, not the freeze commit `08cbd12`. I proceeded anyway because the only commit in between adds candidate-excluded metadata: the round-13 assignments, the manifest and `stages.json`. The recomputed candidate ID is the same in the real repo and in a full clone at `08cbd12`, so I reviewed the frozen candidate.

## F-DG1-134: fixed and verified (CLOSED_VERIFIED)
- **Planted files:** I planted files with the extensions `.mts`, `.mjs`, `.cts`, `.cjs`, `.js` and `.jsx`, plus a nested `.mts`, into a real module directory of a throwaway clone. Each contained a `node:crypto` namespace import and an import that reaches past another module's public `index.ts`.
  - The round-12 lint gave 0 violations for them.
  - The fixed lint flags every file for both problems.
- **`.tsx` files:** these are parsed correctly. A `require` inside JSX text that contains an apostrophe is still caught.
- **Real module tree:** it has no non-`.ts`/`.tsx` files and 0 violations in every module.
- **Tests:** `architecture.test.ts` passes 127/127.

## New finding: F-DG1-135 (Low, not a mandatory violation)
- **Location:** `apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts:177` and `:461`, against `apps/api/tsconfig.build.json:10` and `vitest.config.ts:21`.
- **Problem:** the fixed lint now treats any `*.test.mts`/`.cts`/`.js`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`/`.jsx` file as a test. Test files may import `modules.ts`, `architecture.testkit.ts` and `vitest`. But the build only excludes `*.test.ts` and `*.test.tsx`, and vitest only runs `*.test.ts`. So such a file is never run as a test, yet ships in `dist` with those relaxed rules.
- **Reproduced:** I planted `kpi/zzgap.test.mts` importing `../../modules.ts`.
  - The lint reported 0 violations.
  - The build exited 0 and produced `dist/.../zzgap.test.mjs`, which ran when imported.
  - vitest never picked it up.
  - The same file named `zzgap.mts` was flagged.
- **Impact:** limited. The only extra imports allowed are the module map (data only), the test-only lint and vitest. All the lint's other rules still apply. It isn't a regression, because before the fix these files weren't scanned at all.
- **Suggested fix:** either narrow the test pattern to what the build excludes and vitest runs, or widen the build exclusion to every `*.test.<ext>`. Then pin the chosen rule in `architecture.test.ts:763`.

AC-1 (effect) is blocked because the registry is unreachable from the sandbox. Its test package has no lockfile, so pnpm must fetch metadata online. The assignment expected the full-repo install to be blocked as well, but the sandboxed frozen install ran offline from a copy of the local package store and passed.

All 8 assigned requirements are IMPLEMENTED with final gate DG1, and every evidence file they cite exists. No Critical, High or mandatory finding is open.

During my run the domain reviewer's auto-commit (`ae769af`) landed. I looked only at its file names, and the candidate ID is unchanged. I didn't read any other reviewer's round-13 record. The throwaway clone and scratch files have been removed.
